prompt: Which device at the top of a well stops a blowout?
funFact: A BOP can seal the well in seconds if pressure gets out of control.

prompt: Which well log measures the natural radioactivity of rocks?
funFact: Shales usually give higher gamma ray readings than clean sandstones.

prompt: What does OPEC stand for?

options.label: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
Organization of Pipeline and Energy Companies

answerLabel: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
funFact: OPEC was founded in Baghdad in 1960.

prompt: What does "pigging" a pipeline mean?

options.label: Sending a device through to clean or inspect it

answerLabel: Sending a device through to clean or inspect it
funFact: The name may come from the squealing noise early pigs made in the pipe.

prompt: What is a Permit to Work used for?
funFact: Permits make sure hazards are checked and isolations are in place before work starts.

prompt: What does FPSO stand for?
funFact: Nigeria's deepwater fields use FPSOs, such as those at Bonga and Egina.

prompt: What does PPE stand for?
funFact: Hard hat, safety boots, gloves, glasses and coveralls are all PPE.

prompt: What do we call the steel pipe cemented into a well to keep it stable?
funFact: Casing protects groundwater zones and holds the hole open.

prompt: In a petroleum system, the "source rock" is where oil is…
funFact: Source rock makes the oil, reservoir rock stores it, and the seal keeps it in.

prompt: Nigeria's large bitumen (tar sand) deposits are best known in which state?
funFact: The bitumen belt runs through Ondo, Ogun, Edo and Lagos States.

prompt: What is the set of valves on top of a producing well nicknamed?
funFact: Early valve stacks looked like decorated trees, and the name stuck.

prompt: Which country is currently the world's largest oil producer?
funFact: Shale oil drove the US to the top in the late 2010s.

prompt: Which tiny fossils help geologists date rocks from wells?
funFact: They are tiny enough for thousands to fit in a teaspoon of rock cuttings.

prompt: Who can stop a job if it looks unsafe?
funFact: Most companies give everyone Stop Work Authority. Use it!

prompt: What is the design capacity of the Dangote Petroleum Refinery?
funFact: It is Africa's largest refinery and among the world's largest single-train refineries.

prompt: True or false: if you can no longer smell H₂S, the danger has passed.
funFact: High levels of H₂S can knock out your sense of smell. Trust your gas detector, not your nose.

prompt: Hydraulic fracturing (fracking) cracks rock using…
funFact: Sand in the fluid props the cracks open so oil and gas can flow.

prompt: How many points of contact should you keep when climbing a ladder?
funFact: Two hands and a foot, or two feet and a hand, at all times.

prompt: Who drilled the first modern commercial oil well, in Pennsylvania in 1859?
funFact: The well was only about 21 metres deep.

prompt: Oil and gas formed mainly from…
funFact: Sorry, dinosaur fans. Most oil comes from microscopic sea life buried in mud.

prompt: Which of these is NOT made from crude oil?
funFact: Cotton grows on plants. Polyester, however, is made from oil.

prompt: True or false: every oil discovery is worth producing.
funFact: A find must be big enough and cheap enough to produce before it counts as commercial.

prompt: True or false: gas flaring wastes a valuable resource and adds greenhouse gases to the air.
funFact: Captured gas can power homes and industries instead.

prompt: What is burning off gas at a flare stack called?
funFact: Venting releases gas without burning it, which is worse for the climate.

prompt: True or false: a near miss doesn't need reporting because nobody was hurt.
funFact: Near misses are free lessons. Report them before the next one becomes an injury.

prompt: Selling petrol at a filling station is part of which sector?
funFact: Upstream finds and produces, midstream moves and stores, downstream refines and sells.

prompt: In the hierarchy of controls, which control is the MOST effective?
funFact: Remove the hazard completely, and nobody can be hurt by it.

prompt: What is "Brent"?
funFact: Many Nigerian crudes are priced against Brent.

prompt: Before entering a confined space, you must first…
funFact: The air inside may lack oxygen or contain toxic or flammable gas.

prompt: What do we call the empty pore space inside a rock?
funFact: Porosity is how much the rock can hold. Permeability is how easily fluids flow through it.

prompt: How many US gallons are in one barrel of oil?
funFact: That's about 159 litres.

prompt: Long-term exposure to benzene, found in crude oil and petrol, can cause…
funFact: That is why benzene exposure is monitored in the oil and gas industry.

prompt: Which agency regulates Nigeria's upstream oil and gas sector under the PIA?
funFact: Its midstream and downstream counterpart is the NMDPRA.

prompt: True or false: natural gas is made up mainly of methane.
funFact: Methane (CH₄) is the simplest hydrocarbon: one carbon atom and four hydrogen atoms.

prompt: What does NORM stand for?
funFact: NORM can build up as scale inside pipes and vessels.

prompt: Which rock type holds most of the world's oil and gas?
funFact: Sandstones and limestones have pore space where oil and gas can collect.

prompt: What does hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) smell like at low levels?
funFact: H₂S is toxic and flammable, and it is heavier than air.

prompt: What is a reservoir rock?

options.label: A rock that stores oil or gas
A rock that holds drinking water only
A rock used to build dams

answerLabel: A rock that stores oil or gas
funFact: A good reservoir needs both porosity and permeability.

prompt: What does "energy transition" mean?

options.label: Moving a rig from one site to another
Moving from fossil fuels toward lower-carbon energy

answerLabel: Moving from fossil fuels toward lower-carbon energy
funFact: Natural gas is often called a "transition fuel".

prompt: What does a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) tell you?

options.label: A chemical's hazards and how to handle it safely

answerLabel: A chemical's hazards and how to handle it safely
funFact: Read the SDS before you use any unfamiliar chemical.

prompt: What does API gravity tell you about a crude oil?

options.label: How light or heavy it is

answerLabel: How light or heavy it is
funFact: The higher the API gravity, the lighter the crude.

prompt: What does the NCDMB promote?

options.label: Nigerian content in the oil and gas industry

answerLabel: Nigerian content in the oil and gas industry
funFact: NCDMB stands for Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board.

prompt: What does Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) do?
funFact: It stops equipment from starting up while someone is working on it.

prompt: What is one main job of drilling mud?

options.label: Control well pressure and carry rock cuttings up
Paint the inside of the pipe

answerLabel: Control well pressure and carry rock cuttings up
funFact: Mud also cools the drill bit and keeps the hole from collapsing.

prompt: True or false: molecule for molecule, methane traps more heat than carbon dioxide.
funFact: That's why methane leaks matter so much.

prompt: What is "Bonny Light"?

options.label: A gas field in the Sahara

funFact: Bonny Light is prized because it is light and low in sulphur.

prompt: When should a Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) be done?

options.label: At the end of the year

funFact: A JHA breaks the job into steps and checks each step for hazards.

prompt: True or false: a "trap" stops oil and gas from escaping to the surface.
funFact: Without a trap and a seal, oil keeps rising until it leaks out at the surface.

prompt: Gas production is often reported in…

options.label: Million standard cubic feet per day

answerLabel: Million standard cubic feet per day
funFact: You will often see it written as MMscf/d.

prompt: Where do you go when the emergency alarm sounds?
funFact: At the muster point, everyone can be counted quickly.

prompt: What is an unexpected flow of formation fluid into a well while drilling called?
funFact: A kick that isn't controlled can become a blowout.

prompt: Which rock usually acts as the "lid" that seals oil in a reservoir?
funFact: Fine-grained shale and salt let almost nothing pass through.

prompt: Where was oil first found in commercial quantities in Nigeria, in 1956?
funFact: Shell-BP made the discovery in present-day Bayelsa State.

prompt: Which refinery process separates crude oil by boiling point?
funFact: Gases come off at the top of the column and heavy residue stays at the bottom.

prompt: Why do oil and gas move upward through rock?
funFact: Oil and gas float on the water that fills most rock pores.

prompt: What is the tall tower on a drilling rig called?
funFact: It holds the equipment used to raise and lower pipe.

prompt: What does NAPE stand for?
funFact: You're at its conference right now!

prompt: True or false: PPE is the last line of defence.
funFact: Use PPE only after higher controls such as elimination, engineering and procedures.

prompt: True or false: Nigeria has the largest proven natural gas reserves in Africa.
funFact: Nigeria's gas reserves are over 200 trillion cubic feet.

prompt: True or false: a "dry hole" is a well that finds no commercial oil or gas.
funFact: Dry holes are disappointing, but the data still teaches the team about the area.

prompt: Which extinguisher is best for a fire on live electrical equipment?
funFact: Water conducts electricity, so never use it on live electrical fires.

prompt: Pumping water into a reservoir to push more oil out is called…
funFact: This is a common form of secondary recovery.

prompt: In what year did Nigeria join OPEC?
funFact: Nigeria joined 11 years after Nigerian independence and OPEC's founding.

prompt: Roughly what temperature range "cooks" buried organic matter into oil?
funFact: Geologists call this the "oil window". Hotter than that, you mostly get gas.

prompt: What is the best way to prevent heat stress on a hot site?

options.label: Drink water often and take shaded rest breaks

answerLabel: Drink water often and take shaded rest breaks
funFact: Thirst is a late sign. Drink water before you feel thirsty.

prompt: LPG, or cooking gas, is mainly…
funFact: LPG stands for Liquefied Petroleum Gas.

prompt: In primary recovery, oil flows to the surface using…
funFact: Primary recovery usually produces only a small share of the oil in place.

prompt: In what year was Nigeria's Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) signed into law?
funFact: It took almost 20 years to pass.

prompt: What does "sweet" crude oil mean?

options.label: It sells at a higher price

funFact: High-sulphur crude is called "sour". Please don't taste-test either one!

prompt: Which of these is NOT part of the fire triangle?
funFact: Remove any one side of the triangle and the fire goes out.

prompt: What is a well drilled to test a brand-new, unproven area called?
funFact: The name comes from early American drillers working in wild country.

prompt: True or false: oil wells are always drilled straight down.
funFact: Directional and horizontal drilling let one platform reach many targets.

prompt: What is an arch-shaped fold in rock layers called?
funFact: Oil and gas float up and collect at the top of the arch.

prompt: Which part of the drill string actually cuts the rock?
funFact: Some bits use industrial diamonds to grind through hard rock.

prompt: What colour should a gas cooker flame be when it is burning well?
funFact: A yellow or orange flame can mean poor combustion and carbon monoxide risk.

prompt: Which is Nigeria's main oil- and gas-producing area?
funFact: The Niger Delta is one of the largest delta systems in the world.

prompt: Many companies require hearing protection when noise reaches about…
funFact: Noise-induced hearing loss is permanent, but it can be prevented.

prompt: LNG is natural gas that has been…
funFact: At about −162 °C, gas shrinks to about 1/600th of its volume.

prompt: Which survey uses sound waves to "see" rock layers deep underground?
funFact: Sound bounces off rock layers, and computers turn the echoes into pictures.

prompt: Which equipment splits the well stream into oil, gas and water?
funFact: Gravity does most of the work: gas rises, oil floats, water sinks.
